name: modeltraining-yolo26-desktop
productName: 基于YOLO26的铝型方管缺陷智能分类检测系统
description: 基于YOLO26的铝型方管缺陷智能分类检测系统

scripts.build:web: npm run clean:web && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:server
scripts.build:portable: npm run runtime:prepare && npm run runtime:verify && npm run build
scripts.electron:package: npm run clean:out && npm run build:portable && electron-forge package --platform=win32 --arch=x64 && npm run package:verify
scripts.electron:make: npm run clean:out && npm run build:portable && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/make-win-x64.ps1
